jsonLd.datasetDescription: Median prices per m² and property sales volume in {nom}, aggregated from the public DVF database (DGFiP).

intro.sansVentes: In {nom}, property transactions are not published in the DVF database (Livre foncier regime in Alsace-Moselle, or too few sales). You will find the observed reference rents below, and our team provides a free personalised valuation of your property on request.
intro.v0: The property market in {nom} shows a median price of {prix}, calculated from sales actually recorded by the French tax authorities (DVF database). {fenetre, select, 36m {Over the last three years of published data} other {Over the last twelve months of published data}}, {ventes, plural, =0 {no sales were analysed} one {# sale was analysed} other {# sales were analysed}} in the town.
intro.v1: How much is a property worth in {nom}? Deeds of sale recorded by the DGFiP (DVF database) show a median value of {prix}. This price level is based on {ventes, plural, one {# transaction observed} other {# transactions observed}} {fenetre, select, 36m {over three years} other {over twelve months}} in the town.
intro.v2: In {nom}, officially recorded property sales {fenetre, select, 36m {over the last three years} other {over the last twelve months}} - {ventes, number, integer} in total - set the median price at {prix}. These figures come from public DVF data, the same data used by notaries and professionals.

marche.volumeFortV0: {ventes, number, integer} sales {fenetre, select, 36m {over three years} other {in twelve months}} make {nom} a deep market: median prices are solid and comparables plentiful to value a property down to the address.

appart.question: What is the price per m² of a flat in {nom} in {annee}?
appart.reponse: The median price of a flat in {nom} is {prix, number, currency}/m², based on sales recorded in the DVF database {fenetre, select, 36m {over the last three years of published data} other {over the last twelve months of published data}}. Depending on condition, floor and fittings, the actual value of a property may differ significantly from this median.

loyer.question: What rent for a flat in {nom}?
loyer.reponse: The average advertised rent observed is about €{loyerM2, number, decimal1}/m² including charges (ANIL {millesime} estimates, based on data from Groupe SeLoger and leboncoin). For a 45 m² one-bedroom flat, this represents a rent of around {loyerT2, number, currency} per month.

estimer.question: How can I get an accurate valuation of my property in {nom}?
estimer.reponse: Use our free online estimator: it compares your property with actual sales in your neighbourhood and gives you an instant range. For a precise appraisal, a visit remains essential - your local advisor will call you back free of charge.
